purpose: Evaluation protocol for the corrected (pick/ban-fixed) dataset. Frozen before any model is trained on it so the partitions cannot be re-cut after seeing results.

supersedes.reason: bans were encoded as picks (STRATZ camelCase isPick); presence vectors had 12 flags per side in 82,739 rows

rule.order: start_time ascending, match_id as tie-break (mergesort, stable)
rule.boundaries: epoch-second thresholds placed between distinct start_time values, so no timestamp appears in two partitions
rule.match_isolation: one row per match_id; match_id is unique in the dataset and never crosses a boundary

validation.role: variant selection, hyperparameters, early stopping, calibration checks
validation.note: start_time_min equals the train maximum only because it is the inclusive lower bound of the open interval (train uses start_time <= max, validation uses start_time > train_max)

test.role: single final evaluation of one already-selected candidate; never for selection

contamination.reason: The chronological tail of this corpus (2026-04-05 .. 2026-08-28) is the same match population as the 2026-10-28 ablation's test window. All 10,211 holdout match_ids are present in that previously inspected window, whose metrics were already reported.
contamination.consequence: This partition may be used as an internal reference and for regression checks, but a result on it is NOT a fresh held-out number and must not be presented as one.
contamination.clean_holdout_requirement: Collect matches with start_time > 1787903076 (after 2026-08-28T07:44:36Z, the newest timestamp in the corpus) and freeze them before evaluating any candidate. No such data exists in the repository as of 2026-10-28.

forbidden: choosing features or hyperparameters from test metrics
reporting a test result as a first, untouched final evaluation
re-cutting these boundaries after observing results
